name: airo-doffy-wrm-delta-c9-bs32
description: WRM_delta training on the local tightness-labelled cylinder dataset, cluster 9, 1 GPU, 8 CPUs, batch size 32

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_wrm_delta_cluster9_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-wrm-delta-cluster9-bs32.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
